title: One interior guard step
statement: Let $b$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $u,j\in\mathbb N$ with $u<b+1$ and $j<|x|$. For any Boolean output string $out$, one step of the guard machine with parameter $b$, from position $j$ in phase $u$, gives the configuration at position $j+1$ in phase $u+1$, with output unchanged.
